title: Implement authorized active Plant selector and CheckIn command authorization
verify: Selector excludes unauthorized and archived Plants
Backend rejects CheckIn start/mutation for missing/revoked grant, archived Plant, disabled membership, invalid session, and Consultant operational mutation
UI cannot submit data for a Plant not present in ActorContext
evidence_required: Authorized selector and CheckIn authorization test output
constraints: Boss may see active Plants through role authority; Engineer and Consultant require granted PlantAccessGrant visibility
Consultant cannot start operational mutations in MVP
Unauthorized Plant existence is not leaked through selector, errors, or counts
invariants: Revoked PlantAccessGrant blocks future normal visibility and context retrieval
verification_targets: Selector excludes unauthorized and archived Plants
